5.11.5.3.2 BSW Scheduler Mode Switch Request Terminate API
Description:
BSW Scheduler Mode Switch Request Terminate API is invoked by
the BSW Scheduler when the transition to a mode switch request is
completed. See [SWS_Rte_02563].
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_03896] ⌈
void SchM_[<client>_]<api>Hook_<bsnp>_[<vi>_<ai>]
_<name>_Terminate
(<param>)
Where <api> is the BSW Scheduler API Name (i.e. Switch) w.r.t
mode switch initiation,
<bsnp>
is
the
BSW
Scheduler
Name
Prefix
according
to
[SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594],
<vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module,
<ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module and
<name> is the provided (providedModeGroup) ModeDeclara-
tionGroupPrototype name.
The parameters of the API shall be the same as the corresponding
BSW Scheduler API. See [SWS_Rte_07255].
The sub part in square brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no
vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module. See
[SWS_Rte_07528].
⌋(SRS_Rte_00003, SRS_Rte_00004, SRS_Rte_00045)
